clue.text: Tree destroyed a lawn? So odd

indicators.note: something destroyed is wrecked and broken up, so these letters are reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: A gardener's lament: a tree has ruined the lawn, which is strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandalwood is a fragrant tropical tree prized for its scented timber.

clue.text: Greek girl in elegant style, topless

indicators.note: the girl's name is placed inside the trimmed word for elegant style
topless means the word loses its first letter, its top in a down entry

parts.note: chic is elegant stylishness
Ellen is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A Greek woman dressed elegantly but without a top, as on a sunny beach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' leaves HIC; 'Greek girl' tempts you to look for Helen as the definition, but the girl is Ellen and Greek is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Hellenic is the adjective for things belonging to Greece and its people.

clue.text: Disease that is found in some Scotsmen?

indicators.note: the abbreviation for that is is found sitting inside the plural of the Scottish name

parts.note: Rab is a typically Scottish man's name (short for Robert), so several Scotsmen are Rabs
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Asks whether a disease is particularly common among Scottish men.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark covers 'some Scotsmen' meaning several men called Rab, a stock Scottish name, not a few Scots in general.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabies is a fatal viral infection spread by animal bites.

clue.text: Drug-free hell? Bad luck!

parts.note: HELL with the drug E (ecstasy) removed leaves H and LL, the abbreviations for ... (as on pencils) and ... (Ll, as Chambers gives it)

explanation.surface: Someone coming off drugs finds life hellish, and gets only sympathy for it.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking E, ecstasy, out of HELL leaves HLL, which is the abbreviated form of the answer: H for hard and LL for lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard lines is a British exclamation of sympathy for someone's misfortune, much like tough luck.

clue.text: Puck's set in place a punishing task

parts.note: Puck is the setter, so Puck's (Puck is) becomes I'm from the setter's own point of view
to set something in place is to position it

explanation.surface: Puck, the mischievous sprite, places a punishment on someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Crossword setters often refer to themselves by their pseudonym, so 'Puck's' = I'M.
explanation.definitionFit: An imposition is a piece of written work set as a school punishment, a burden imposed.

clue.text: Drug writer put in mostly lower case

indicators.note: the writing implement is put inside the shortened word for lower
the shortened word forms a case around the writing implement
mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: nether means lower, as in the nether regions
a pen is a writer, an instrument for writing

explanation.surface: Typographic jargon: a drug's name set in lower case by a writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' leaves NETHE. 'lower case' reads like printing jargon, but 'lower' is the synonym and 'case' wraps it round the writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepenthe is a legendary drug in Homer that banished grief and memory.

clue.text: Vocal onslaught from Siamese?

indicators.note: vocal says the phrase is spoken, so its sound gives the answer

parts.note: an onslaught (raid) from a Siamese person, someone from Thailand, is a Thai raid

explanation.surface: Asks whether a verbal attack might come from a Siamese cat or person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thai raid' said aloud is the answer, and a tirade is itself a vocal onslaught, so the whole clue defines it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is a long angry speech of denunciation, an attack in words.

clue.text: See 24
Tree providing cover in the middle of a kingdom

indicators.note: the word for cover is put in the middle of the word for kingdom

parts.note: a realm is a kingdom
a cap is a cover, as on a bottle or pen

explanation.surface: A tree shelters the heart of a kingdom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'providing' is only a link; 'in the middle of' places the cover inside the kingdom word, with A standing in front.
explanation.definitionFit: The areca palm is a tropical palm tree that yields betel nuts.

clue.text: Girl getting diamonds cut in time

indicators.note: the shortened slang word for diamonds sits inside the word for a period of time

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: cut means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: A girl having her diamonds cut in time for some occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' leaves IC; ICE as slang for diamonds is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: A forename for a female: Erica is a girl's name, taken from the Latin for heather.

clue.text: Didn't rush boy about to tell a story before dinner starts

indicators.note: about means the word for boy is turned round

parts.note: a lad is a boy
to tell a story is to lie, a fib

indicators.note: starts means the first letter of dinner is taken

explanation.surface: A boy dawdles, about to tell a story before dinner begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the boy round to give DAL; 'Didn't rush' is the definition, a verb in the past tense.
explanation.definitionFit: To dally is to dawdle or waste time, so dallied means took one's time.

clue.text: I reflected about girl being too old

indicators.note: the reversed self-word goes around the girl's name
reflected means read backwards, as in a mirror

parts.note: the ego is the I, the self
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone muses on a girl who is past the age limit.
explanation.walkthrough: EGO reflected is OGE, which goes about VERA: O-VERA-GE.
explanation.definitionFit: Overage means beyond the permitted or suitable age limit.

clue.text: See 4
Most fastidious sort of diet — it's not allowing for starters

indicators.note: a sort of diet is a version of it, here the letters reshaped
for starters means the first letters of these words are taken

explanation.surface: Advice on a picky diet that bans starters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges DIET, ITS and N A, the starts of 'not allowing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dainty can mean fussy or particular, so the daintiest eater is the most fastidious.

clue.text: Row about inexperienced doctor in item destined for noticeboard?

indicators.note: the word for row goes about the word for inexperienced

parts.note: a din is a row, a loud noise
raw means inexperienced, as in a raw recruit
GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor
taken as written

explanation.surface: A row breaks out over a junior doctor in the practice.
explanation.walkthrough: DIN about RAW gives D-RAW-IN, followed by GP and IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawing pins (thumbtacks) are used to fix notices to a board.

clue.text: See 23
Fiancee limit: one-off, never to be repeated?

indicators.note: off in the sense of gone wrong signals that the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A fiancee sets a limit: this is a one-off.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that happens only once in a lifetime is unique, unlikely ever to recur.

clue.text: Air conditioning devices reordered — essentially wrong size, one's admitted

indicators.note: the numeral one is let in among the rearranged letters
reordered says the letters are put in a new sequence
essentially means the core letters of wrong are taken, without its ends

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Air conditioners have been ordered again because the wrong size was installed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially wrong' gives RON; RON plus SIZE is rearranged and I is admitted.
explanation.definitionFit: Ionizers condition air by charging particles so that dust and pollen drop out.

clue.text: Making 5 grand

definitions.meaning: 5 is the answer to 5-down, a punishment that is imposed

explanation.definitionFit: Imposing describes something grand in appearance; it is also the act of setting a burden on someone.

clue.text: Where one is kept in for ENT observation

definitions.text: Where one is kept in for ENT observation

parts.words: Where one is kept in for ENT observation
parts.note: the letters ENT are at the ... of the first word, and the place is where one is held

explanation.walkthrough: ENT is not ear, nose and throat here: those three letters sit in the middle of the first word, a pun on the place.
explanation.definitionFit: A detention centre is an institution for holding young offenders or immigrants.

clue.text: Time to complain, say it's a pain

indicators.note: say means the word is spoken, giving the variant spelling

parts.note: to whinge is to complain

explanation.surface: Time to grumble, perhaps, because something hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: A twinge is a sudden sharp pain.

clue.text: Resin from joint buddy?

parts.note: co- as a prefix means joint, as in co-owner
a pal is a buddy

explanation.surface: Asks whether a resin comes from a friend's shared joint.
explanation.definitionFit: Copal is a hard aromatic resin from tropical trees, used in varnish.

clue.text: See 19
Romanian readies animal to go around unknown city

parts.note: lei are the currency of Romania; readies is British slang for cash

indicators.note: the animal's letters go around the symbol for an unknown

parts.note: a pig is an animal
z is an unknown in algebra

explanation.surface: Romanian cash for an animal to travel around an unknown city.
explanation.walkthrough: Readies is British slang for ready cash; LEI is the plural of the leu, Romania's currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Leipzig is a major city in eastern Germany.

clue.text: Stroke of luck — after seeing horseshoe, openings appear

indicators.note: openings means the first letter of each of these words is taken

explanation.surface: Good luck arrives after spotting a horseshoe.
explanation.definitionFit: A lash is a stroke of a whip.

clue.text: Order some bananas with drink

parts.note: a hand is a bunch of bananas
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: A request for a few bananas and something to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Hands up is a command, as from a gunman, to raise your arms.

clue.text: Help! Instep hurt playing game

indicators.note: playing signals that the letters are moved around in play

explanation.surface: A cry for help from someone who hurt their foot playing a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunt the slipper is a children's party game of passing a slipper around a circle.

clue.text: Cat returns with secret source of sweetener

indicators.note: returns means the cat's name is read backwards

parts.note: Gus is the theatre cat in T.S. Eliot's Old Possum poems
arcane means secret or mysterious

explanation.surface: A cat comes back with a hidden source of sugar.
explanation.walkthrough: GUS returned is SUG, followed by ARCANE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar cane is the grass whose stems are crushed for sugar.

clue.text: One caring about lack of awareness

indicators.note: about means the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: Someone who cares about a lack of understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignorance is a lack of knowledge or awareness.
